title: PCP envelope
description: Fields common to every PCP frame. Each WebSocket text message carries exactly one frame (a JSON object).

id.description: Unique id of this frame (per sender, per session). Results and pongs point back with 'ref'.

ts.description: When the sender created the frame.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context header value, so an event and the actions it causes share one OpenTelemetry trace.
